summary: Second-model AI auto-review for DeepSeek Harness approval requests: a read-only reviewer subagent decides allow/deny on the approval answerer chain, with fail-closed fallback and full session-log audit.

Declarative, ordered allow/deny/ask permission rules for DeepSeek Harness: match tool names, arguments (glob/regex), workspace paths, and network targets (domain/IP/port/scheme), plus a Codex-style process-level network policy.
Delivery quality gate for DeepSeek Harness: grill the requirements, test the implementation, prove the delivery, and gate the handoff with a deliverable/rework decision.

Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness — a capability seam (ctx.memory service + local SQLite provider + memory tool + frozen snapshot injection), not another memory warehouse.

Unified DSH checkpoints: session, workspace, and config three-state snapshots with one-shot /checkpoint and /rewind rollback, a checkpoint tool, automatic interval snapshots, a Settings-page timeline with pairwise diffs, and seed-replay session recovery.
Web panel for managing MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers in DeepSeek Harness: inspect, start/stop, view logs, and configure servers, with automatic backups.

Terminal-style input history for the DeepSeek Harness web composer: edge-first arrows with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, workspace recall, and sliding-context awareness.
Pin important sessions in DeepSeek Harness so they stay visible, sorted first, and protected from cleanup.
Session synchronization for DeepSeek Harness: push/pull session logs to remote storage with configurable auto push/pull.

Runtime-switchable model output styles for DeepSeek Harness: a Markdown style library (six built-ins, Claude Code-parity proactive/learning), /style command, session-scoped persistence, system-prompt injection, a plugin renderer registry, per-session/per-tool rules, and /export rendering.
LSP actions for DeepSeek Harness: the IDE-integration plugin that exposes language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, and fixes to the agent.
Background agents for DeepSeek Harness: run subagents as background jobs with a structured task board and approval controls.
Claude Code to DeepSeek Harness migration: import CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, slash commands, and session history — approval-gated and idempotent.
Translate text and files inside DeepSeek Harness with quality checks; also fixes broken JSON output from models.
Run local AI models inside DeepSeek Harness: Ollama/LM Studio/local endpoints as drop-in model routes.
Mask sensitive values in DeepSeek Harness sessions: redaction rules for secrets, with an in-memory allowlist and a controlled reveal workflow.
Deterministic data profiling, cleaning, and verification for DeepSeek Harness: DAMA scorecard, content-hash dedupe, metric expectations, and drift checks.
Plugin quality scoring for the DSH ecosystem: evaluate plugins against checks and produce evidence-backed compliance reports.
Test Drive: run plugins in a disposable sandbox environment (temporary DSH_HOME) and score the results as JSON/Markdown.
Prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak defense for DeepSeek Harness: Aho-Corasick detection with allow/ask/block interception, sanitized audit events, and a recursive-delete pre-execution gate.

Cost governance for DeepSeek Harness: aggregated token/cost metering per model, session and day, budget caps with threshold alerts and over-limit policies, carbon footprint estimation, per-model latency benchmarks, and the /budget command.

Read-only performance diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness: session load/restore timing, spill-hit counts, compaction count and trigger, context-injection volume (AGENTS.md/skills/tool-schema token share), and LLM cache hit rate — surfaced via /fast.
Observability for DeepSeek Harness: request tracing, telemetry, log buffering, and retry visibility.
Cross-platform native desktop control for DeepSeek Harness (Windows first): screen_shot, screen_read, click/type/scroll/key, and app_list/app_launch — approval-gated, never stealing foreground focus.
Voice for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-speech and speech-to-text with mute and speak-to-chat controls.

Unified static-image generation router for DeepSeek Harness: one image_generate tool with standard parameters, config-driven engine routing (OpenAI Images, Zhipu CogView, and any compatible endpoint), health-aware fallback, durable workspace attachments, and per-session quota accounting.
Industry research toolkit: structured company/industry dives with source capture and auditable research trails.
Research reports with integrity: evidence-linked reports whose content hash seals the directory of sources.
Fund research: analyze funds with returns, holdings, and performance decomposition.

Local document knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: library_add/remove/list, hybrid semantic+keyword library_search with diversity re-ranking and lost-in-the-middle avoidance, citation-aware injection, library_cite_check and library_diagnose — SQLite-backed index, local embedding, zero model downloads.
The DSH plugin development guide as an installable skill: packaging, contracts, checks, and a pack verifier for builds.
GitHub for DeepSeek Harness: PR/issue/repo/file tools, reviews, and CI checks — every write gated by human approval, token never logged.
Security skill-pack provider: pre-packaged security review skills with a risk card; ships both host and client faces.

TickTick (Dida365) task bridge for DeepSeek Harness: a session-header task panel (list filter, quick add, complete, delete, due dates, drag reorder), eleven curated ticktick_* tools, and a plugin settings card over the official TickTick MCP endpoint.
Read-only MCP server exposing the dsh-plugin-certification registry: certification grades, snapshots and five-dimension evidence for DeepSeek Harness plugins.

Multi-channel decision and remote-control bridge for DeepSeek Harness: approval/question cards from any workspace mirrored to IM chat (WeChat iLink, Telegram, Feishu) with stable #token ids and P{n} numbering, answered from chat through the native pending waterfall — fail-closed sender ownership, session console, and proactive reach_send.

Automatic strong/cheap model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: intent-gated tier landing on the agent/request waterfall, plan-mode handoff (strong plans, cheap implements), deterministic high-risk guards on tools/pre-execute, and failure escalation with TTL fallback.

Plugin-author upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness, new-generation single package: one corridor index reads the caller peer band and routes it to the matching closed corridor card (dsh 0.1.3-alpha.1 -> 0.1.5-rc.1 and 0.1.5-rc.2 -> 0.1.6-alpha.2), with a zero-dependency seam scanner shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.
